title: Checkout App: Branding

fontFamilies.title: Font families

roundness.title: Roundness

ExternalLinksType.description: This is a definition of the External Websites settings.

links.title: External Links
links.description: External links list shown as a choice list in the app. Each entry needs a URL and a display name.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique id of this entry. A store or workstation changes or removes the entry by its id.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the web site to display in the choice list in app.

shareAuthorizationToken.title: Share authorization token
shareAuthorizationToken.description: Set true to share authorization token with this website.

shareRetailInformation.title: Share retail information
shareRetailInformation.description: Set true to share retail info like: countryCode, businessunitId, workstationId, operatorId, tenantId.
